changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwfinancialdocuments AS SELECT fd.id, fd.document_number, fd.document_type, fd.status, fd.patient_id, fd.encounter_id, fd.parent_document_id, fd.total_amount, fd.currency, fd.created_date, fd.created_by, fd.last_modified_date, fd.last_modified_by, fd.document_subtype, fd.eligibility_reference, fd.claim_reference, fd.adjustment_reason FROM public.financial_documents fd;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwfinancialdocuments TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwfinancialdocuments FROM report_user;
